question: What kind of money does each system settle in?
answer: 30 systems and money instruments, side by side: 5 stablecoin, 10 commercial-bank deposit token, 3 central-bank unit, 1 off-ledger final settlement, 1 carries more than one kind, 10 kind of money not stated in the row. A stablecoin is a claim on its issuer, a deposit token is a claim on one bank, a central-bank unit is a claim on the central bank, and several ledgers only coordinate payments that finally settle somewhere else.

sections.title: How the Crypto Hub reads a cash leg
sections.sub: Compare stablecoins, commercial-bank deposit tokens, central-bank-backed settlement units and orchestration layers without treating them as interchangeable cash. Stablecoin, commercial-bank deposit, central-bank-backed unit and off-ledger final settlement compared without collapsing issuer liability

cells.text: Identify the money issuer: central bank, commercial bank or stablecoin issuer.
Identify the legal claim: reserve, deposit, redemption right or payment-system balance.
Identify its representation: conventional account, private ledger or public-chain token.
Identify eligible access: customer, vetted wallet, participant or settlement bank.
Identify the orchestration layer: application, Swift, Partior or smart contract.
Locate final settlement or redemption on bank books, RTGS, reserve pool or same ledger.
Preserve correction, insolvency, downtime and operating-clock boundaries.
